interface eth1
 ip address 10.0.0.1/31
interface eth2
 ip address 10.0.0.5/31
interface lo

router bgp 65101

 neighbor 10.0.0.0 description SPINE01
 neighbor 10.0.0.4 remote-as 65000
 neighbor 10.0.0.4 description SPINE02

  maximum-paths 2
